sources.entry: StableBar - Customizable menu bar replacement with themes, widgets, popups and AeroSpace, yabai or OmniWM workspaces.

summary.one_liner: StableBar is a native, configurable menu bar replacement for macOS with themes, built-in and script-based widgets, and popups, set up in the app or through a JSON config file.
use_cases: replace the default macOS menu bar
show workspaces from AeroSpace, yabai or OmniWM
display CPU, memory, network, battery or calendar info in the menu bar
add custom script output to the menu bar
configure a menu bar through a JSON file
how_to_run: Download StableBar.dmg from the latest release
Open the DMG and drag StableBar to Applications
Open StableBar and follow setup to pick a preset, theme and placement
Or install with: brew install --cask seb-graf/tap/stablebar
notable: Native Swift/AppKit/SwiftUI with no web view, one panel per display
Any script in any language can be a widget, refreshed on a timer or events
Settings UI and plain JSON config with schema validation
Workspaces widget works with AeroSpace, yabai, OmniWM, or macOS Spaces
Widget and theme store with permission review before running packages
caveats: Requires macOS 14 or later on Apple silicon
Liquid Glass theme is experimental and needs macOS 26
The macOS Spaces workspace source is opt-in and uses a private window-server API
